Name: PrefabBuilder_PkgNameWarningMsg
English:
Package can be created and installed but a valid Package Name is required for publishing via npm.
 - Package Name can only contain lowercase a-z0-9._-
 - Name can only begin with a dot(.) or an underscore(_) if it has a scope.
 - can be no more than 214 characters long
